# ChatParser

> A free, 100% private, browser-based viewer for WhatsApp chat exports (.txt or .zip).

ChatParser transforms raw WhatsApp export files into a beautiful, familiar chat interface — entirely inside your browser. No servers. No uploads. No accounts.

## Core Philosophy

ChatParser uses a Zero-Server Architecture: all parsing, media rendering, and storage happen locally inside your browser's memory. Your chat data never leaves your device.

## Features

- 100% Private: Local-first architecture ensures complete data privacy
- High Performance: Handles 500k+ messages with 60FPS virtual scrolling
- Full Media Support: Native playback for images, videos, audio, and documents
- Smart Search: Filter by date, message type, or instant text search
- Multi-Language & Locale Support: Natively parses WhatsApp chat exports in English, Spanish (Español), Arabic (العربية), and Urdu (اردو) from both Android and iOS devices. Automatically handles localized date/time patterns, 12h/24h formats, native numerals (Arabic-Indic ٠-٩ and Urdu ۰-۹ digits), right-to-left (RTL) directional markers, and localized system notifications
- Group Chat Support: Coloured sender names and avatars for every participant
- PWA Ready: Installable on phone or desktop, with Share Target API integration
- Offline Capable: Works entirely offline once loaded
- Dark & Light Mode: Fully themed, respects system preference
- Bookmarks: Bookmark individual messages for quick reference; bookmarks persist across sessions
- Notes: Attach personal notes to any message; notes are private and stored locally
- Grouped Bookmarks & Notes: Collect multiple related messages into a named group (bookmark group or note group) displayed as a single collapsible card in the Saved panel
- Multi-Select: Long-press or right-click to enter selection mode; select multiple messages at once to bookmark, note, or delete them in bulk
- Delete from View: Remove individual or selected messages from the chat view without affecting the original export file; supports instant undo via a toast notification
- Copy to Clipboard: Copy message text or media captions directly to clipboard via the context menu with instant toast feedback

## Supported Languages & Platforms

- Languages: English, Spanish (Español), Arabic (العربية), Urdu (اردو)
- Platforms: Android and iOS exports (.txt and .zip archives)
- Formats: 12-hour (AM/PM, ص/م, a. m./p. m.) and 24-hour clocks, ASCII and Arabic-Indic numerals, with or without media attachments

## How It Works

1. Export: Open any chat in WhatsApp → Menu → More → Export Chat
2. Include Media: Choose "Include Media" to generate a ZIP file (recommended)
3. Upload: Drag & drop your `.zip` or `.txt` file into ChatParser
4. Relive: Browse your memories in a beautiful, high-speed interface

## Limitations

- Only supports WhatsApp export format (.txt or .zip)
- Does not support WhatsApp backup files (.crypt12, .crypt14, msgstore.db)
- Media files must be exported from WhatsApp as a ZIP to appear in the viewer

## Tech Stack

- Frontend: React 19, TypeScript
- Build Tool: Vite 8
- Core Libraries: IndexedDB (idb), JSZip, Virtua (virtual list rendering)
- Deployment: Vercel
